retrievalProfile.description: A crude, MS Paint-style digital doodle of a yellow cat with jagged red outlines and a cigarette, set against a solid black background.

recipe.visualDefinition: A flat, vibrant yellow feline character with a large head, wide white eyes with tiny red pupils, and a zigzag tail. The character features a thin red jagged outline, a small green and black hat, and a cigarette protruding from a straight-line mouth, all set against a void-like black background.
coreVisualRelationships: Vibrant yellow body against a high-contrast black background
Jagged red outlines defining all shapes and features
Oversized white circular eyes dominating the facial structure
Zigzagging tail mirroring the jaggedness of the line work

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The cat is centered, occupying the majority of the frame with a disproportionately large head.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large white eyes with red pupils serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the large white eyes, moves down to the cigarette, and follows the zigzag tail upward.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Solid black background provides total isolation for the subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Vibrant Yellow (#FFFF00) for the body and tail.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright Red (#FF0000) for outlines and pupils; Pink (#FFC0CB) for ears and nose.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Maximum saturation and high value for the subject against zero value for the background.

twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Draw a crude yellow cat with a large head, zigzag tail, and jagged red outlines using a digital brush that mimics a low-resolution pencil tool.

verificationChecks: Ensure the outline is a jagged red line.
Confirm the background is pure black.
Check that the tail has a sharp zigzag shape.

adjustableVariables: Tail length and number of zigzags
Intensity of the jaggedness in the line work

mustAchieve: High contrast between yellow and black
Visible pixelation in the red outlines

postGenerationChecks: Is the outline red and jagged?
Are the eyes large, white, and circular?
